title: .NET 8 Modular Monolith Pattern
content: Architecture Pattern: .NET 8 Modular Monolith with ASP.NET Core, MediatR, and PostgreSQL. Best for teams under 8 .NET engineers and throughput below 2,500 RPS. Pros: Fast delivery, strict ACID transactions across modules, single Azure App Service deployment. Cons: Shared runtime scaling limits if one module is CPU-bound.

title: Event-Driven .NET Microservices with Azure Service Bus
content: Architecture Pattern: Event-Driven .NET 8 Microservices on AKS using MassTransit, Azure Service Bus, and EF Core Outbox. Best for >5,000 RPS or strict compliance isolation. Pros: Independent scaling and fault isolation. Cons: Eventual consistency complexity and higher Azure infrastructure/DevOps overhead.

title: Hybrid Workflow Control Plane + Cognitive Worker Pattern
content: Architecture Pattern: Deterministic Workflow Control Plane (n8n) + AI Cognitive Workers (Langflow) backed by PostgreSQL/pgvector, integrating with enterprise .NET 8 REST APIs. Best for AI automation requiring strict state machines, audit trails, schema validation, and human-in-the-loop approval.
